why: The whole-PR review of ticket 766's slices S1 to S4 in today's lead tooling (the lint hold, governance.ts, fieldrow.ts, box/RunsFs.ts), judgment code only under 0589's amendments: merge-ready, three finding rows. fieldrow.ts gives main's fieldrow.py rows field for field: a scratch differential ran main's fieldrow.py and fieldrow.ts on the same 200 generated events files and flags (requested profiles first-wins, empty and missing flags and CODEX_MODEL/CODEX_EFFORT, prototype and unknown models, receipts, given times in three offsets) and every parsed row and exit code agreed; the bytes differ only in JSON spacing, which no reader compares. On inputs box.sh never sends they differ (an empty --step, a Z time, a 5.0 or true token count, an empty receipt), the first finding row. governance.ts matches governance.sh on lines and order; 30e527c2's tag change reads CRLF decision files as Python's read_text did (checked by running both on one scratch repo); it exits 2 on an extra argument and 1 outside a repo where the shell gave 0 and 128, which no caller reads apart. box.ts, gc.ts and box/BoxTestGit.ts after the main merge keep main's code with RunsFs.layer(MAIN) in place of RunsProcess, so box rm's exits and lines and gc's 'could not keep its runs/' line and dry-run path hold; the branch merges with origin/main 242e0155 clean. The cross-device refusal keeps the folder and prints it, so no data is lost. loosening.sh: 6 hits, none a loosening.
note: Read-only apart from this row. Pinned Node 26.13.0, nice 19, one worker, TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset. Plants ran in a scratch copy outside the repo (git archive of HEAD with node_modules linked) and were restored. Not run: lint, typecheck, --changed and the full suite (owner rule: CI judges them), git.integration.test.ts and the box rm suites (S2 and S4 reviews ran them). f40d0a62 and 30e527c2 have no run rows; their new CRLF scenario law is planted here. Finding rows: fieldrow.ts and fieldrow.py disagree on inputs box.sh never sends; the lint hold passes a shell or Python file with another extension or a launcher it does not name; the shrink law still accepts the three ported paths back on NOT_YET_PORTED.
